SHIONTHEBRUISER-DEFENSIVE.description: Can only be played if you have played no Attacks this turn, and will stop you from doing so for the rest of it.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DEFENSIVE.title: Defensive
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NONNATIVE.description: Cards from other characters, or colourless cards.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NONNATIVE.title: Non-Native
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STALE.description: Doesn't offer any advantages when upgraded.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-STALE.title: Stale
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LATENT.description: Shuffled at the end of your Deck at the beginning of each fight.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-LATENT.title: Latent
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALDPOWER.description: Exhausts ALL others Emerald Powers in your possession upon play.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-EMERALDPOWER.title: Emerald Power
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMBLAST.description: Exhausts ALL others Team Blasts in ALL PLAYERS' possession upon play.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-TEAMBLAST.title: Team Blast
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BERSERK.description: Gains additional effects if your HP is equal or lower to half of your Max HP.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-BERSERK.title: Berserk
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NOVEL.description:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Random[/gold].
Remove [gold]Novel[/gold] on ALL identical cards.
Afterwards, [gold]Novel[/gold] can't be applied on identical cards this combat.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-NOVEL.title: Novel
